pattern:
python3 - "$F" <<'PY'
import sys,restar
p=sys.argv[1]
s=open(p).read()
old='    if (mode === "hang") { hangCount++; if (hangCount === 1) { setTimeout(start, HANG); return; } }\n    else start();'
new='    if (mode === "hang") { hangCount++; if (hangCount === 1) { setTimeout(start, HANG); return; } start(); return; }\n    start();'
assert old in s, "pattern not found"
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY node --check "$F" echo OK sed -n '42,46p' "$F"
title: Permission request
